detail: Read the public problem statement and extracted the required signal-processing, statistical, and output contracts.
Read the public mapping for CsSnBr3, Cs2SnBr6, and hetero_N2 trajectory filenames.
Inspected only public trajectory files for dataset-name and region-label representation; no reference outputs or evaluator data were accessed.
Use frame and atom counts from /time_fs and /mass_amu to permute /velocities_A_ps into [frame,atom,xyz], with defensive decoding of HDF5 string labels.
Apply mass-weighted COM removal followed by per-atom/per-component full-trajectory mean removal; use zero-padded FFT linear autocorrelation divided by N-lag and normalized at lag zero.
Use hann(N,'symmetric'), raw squared FFT magnitudes without one-sided doubling, xyz sum per atom, atom mean for total PDOS, and trapezoidal unit-integral normalization.
Use raw per-atom 2-3 THz integrated powers for interface share, required two-sided unequal-variance ttest2, pooled-variance Cohen d, and specified Hedges correction.
Wrote the required function entry point and complete runtime generation of vacf.csv, pdos.csv, and phonon_summary.json.
Recorded public-file reads, algorithm decisions, and submission writes.
